Supinated vertical pull: biceps is a prime mover (as in traction-supination/chin-up, where it is primary); inconsistent with the bodyweight version.

Crow/frog stand is a bent-arm, shoulder-flexed support with protraction (serratus, pecs, anterior delt, triceps); it shares the handstand profile by mistake - no overhead elevation, so upper trap/middle delt are not primary. Also add grand_pectoral_sterno_costal + grand_pectoral_claviculaire to secondaires.
Horizontal-adduction/flexion support of the bent-arm balance; pecs absent from all roles.
Straight-arm planche/lean demands a large shoulder-flexion + horizontal-adduction moment; sterno-costal pec is a major contributor, currently absent from every role (only claviculaire listed).

Skull-crusher: only the elbow moves, shoulder is held static; pec and anterior delt do not act as movers (fine as secondaries for JM/Tate press, not here).

A clean without press is a hip-hinge pull to rack; triceps are not movers. NB: fiche points_cles include 'Développé sans cambrer' (copied from clean-et-press) - fix content too.
Windmill: the overhead arm is isometric; the movers are the hip hinge (glutes/hamstrings) and lateral trunk (obliques/QL). Rotator cuff = stabiliser, not primary.
Rectus femoris is a hip flexor (antagonist to the thrust); EMG low (Contreras 2015). Vasti can stay as secondaries.
